title: Global context link
description: A hub's link to the global context repository, at `docs/estate/global.json`. The global repository holds the decision records, standards and exceptions that bind every product, and the Global Architecture Board owns it. A hub has a global layer when it has this file, and a hub without it has none: its requirements say `Global: none`. The file holds the URL only. It names no branch, no tag and no commit. The trunk is asked of the remote each time with `git ls-remote --symref`, and the version a piece of work reads is the `Global:` line on that work's requirements document. Read by `read-global.mjs` and `read-context.mjs`.

url.description: The clone URL of the global context repository. Never a credential: a URL that carries a user name, a password or a token is refused, because this file is committed and every seat reads it. The hub's CI reads the repository with the credential it already uses to read its spokes.
